connector.name: Salesforce Cloud
connector.registryDescription: Salesforce CRM integration - opportunities, accounts, SOQL, file downloads, analytics
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package salesforce-cloud-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aaronsb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SF_USERNAME
env.description: Salesforce username (if set, uses password flow; otherwise client credentials flow)

env.name: SF_PASSWORD
env.description: Salesforce password (required with SF_USERNAME for password flow)

env.name: SF_LOGIN_URL
env.description: Your Salesforce My Domain URL (e.g., https://company.my.salesforce.com)
